title: Corporate Travel Programmes: Platform Subscription Tariff
content:
Two subscription rates are published for every tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes: a monthly platform subscription for the programme, and an annual platform subscription for a company that pays yearly.

| Programme tier | Monthly subscription | Annual subscription where the company pays yearly |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 49.00 USD | 499.00 USD |
| Business Team Programme | 149.00 USD | 1490.00 USD |
| Business Pro Programme | 449.00 USD | 4490.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1250.00 USD | 12500.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 2950.00 USD | 29500.00 USD |
| Business Global Programme | 6500.00 USD | 65000.00 USD |

## Notes to the tariff

1. Both rates are published for each tier. The rate that governs a programme is the one matching the frequency at which that programme is invoiced.
2. The figures above are the platform subscription for the programme itself. The licence charge for traveller seats beyond those the tier carries is published as its own charge and is not contained in these rates.
3. The tariff runs from the Business Starter Programme at 49.00 USD a month up to the Business Global Programme at 6500.00 USD a month; the yearly figures run from 499.00 USD to 65000.00 USD across the same six tiers.

## Points of judgement

**The yearly figure for the Business Enterprise Programme.** The annual platform subscription published for that tier is 12500.00 USD.

**The monthly figure for the Business Team Programme.** The monthly platform subscription published for that tier is 149.00 USD.

**A tier's two rates are not a choice of price for the same invoice.** Each is the published subscription for one invoicing frequency: 4490.00 USD is the Business Pro Programme's yearly figure and 449.00 USD is the same tier's monthly figure.
